controles.affirmation: La societe dispose de 1,007 Md$ de tresorerie contre 717,8 M$ UN AN PLUS TOT / tresorerie en hausse de 40% SUR UN AN
controles.verbatim_source: Bilan condense, colonnes May 2, 2026 | January 31, 2026 | May 3, 2025 : 'Cash and cash equivalents $1,007.3 $717.8 $1,007.4'
controles.correction_proposee: 717,8 M$ est le solde au 31 janvier 2026 (cloture d'exercice), pas 'un an plus tot'. Un an plus tot (2 mai 2025) la tresorerie etait de 1 007,4 M$ : elle est STABLE sur un an, pas en hausse de 40%. Supprimer les deux mentions ou les requalifier explicitement en 'depuis la cloture de janvier 2026'. Les comparaisons dette LT (+20,7%) et capitaux propres (-10,2%) sont, elles, correctement annuelles.

controles.affirmation: Le ratio entre la remuneration du CEO et LE SALAIRE MEDIAN DES EMPLOYES DU GROUPE s'etablit a 355 pour 1 (salaire median de 41 596 $)
controles.verbatim_source: Required Pay Ratio : The Chief Executive Officer's total annual compensation for fiscal year 2025... was $14,775,215. The median employee's total annual compensation for fiscal 2025 was $16,214, resulting in an estimated pay ratio of 911:1. / Supplemental Pay Ratio : ...a supplemental pay ratio that excludes all part-time employees... our median employee in fiscal 2025 was a full-time Assistant Store Manager... $41,596... was estimated to be 355:1
controles.correction_proposee: 355 pour 1 est le ratio SUPPLEMENTAIRE calcule hors salaries a temps partiel. Le ratio reglementaire portant sur l'ensemble des employes est de 911 pour 1, avec un salaire median de 16 214 $. Reformuler : 'ratio reglementaire de 911 pour 1 (median 16 214 $), ou 355 pour 1 en excluant les temps partiels (median 41 596 $)'.

controles.affirmation: Le DOC a ouvert deux dossiers de contournement visant a determiner si des assiettes en papier et des plats en aluminium IMPORTES PAR DOLLAR TREE contournaient des droits antidumping
controles.verbatim_source: In August 2025, the DOC initiated a circumvention case regarding whether paper plates sourced from Cambodia and Malaysia were circumventing the AD and CVD orders by using parent rolls of paper from China. Similarly, in July 2025, the DOC initiated a circumvention case regarding whether aluminum pans produced in Thailand and Vietnam were circumventing... The Company imported both products from impacted countries during the requested retroactive period and after initiation of the cases.
controles.correction_proposee: Les enquetes portent sur les produits ORIGINAIRES de ces pays, pas sur les importations de Dollar Tree en particulier ; Dollar Tree est un importateur affecte, pas la cible de la procedure. Ecrire 'des assiettes en papier (Cambodge, Malaisie) et des plats en aluminium (Thailande, Vietnam), dont Dollar Tree est importateur'.

controles.affirmation: Exposition estimee a environ 56 M$ pour les plats en aluminium et 53 M$ pour les assiettes en papier au 26 mai 2026 ; les plaignants demandent une application retroactive ; la direction ne juge pas la perte probable ; determination finale sur l'aluminium attendue en juillet 2026
controles.verbatim_source: petitioners in both cases have requested the DOC to apply duties retroactively to imports that occurred prior to the initiation of the circumvention cases... In April 2026, the DOC issued a preliminary determination in the aluminum pan case, affirming retroactive application, with a final determination scheduled for July 2026... based on past precedent of DOC rulings, the Company does not believe it is probable that we will incur losses with respect to retroactive duties. Total exposure in these cases is currently estimated to be as high as approximately $56 million for aluminum pans and $53 million for paper plates, as of May 26, 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Rien de faux, mais l'ATT omet un element defavorable deja publie : 'In April 2026, the DOC issued a preliminary determination in the aluminum pan case, affirming retroactive application'. A ajouter, il renforce l'anti-these.
